Score the following storyline given the beginning of the story with one to five stars. Where one star means "Nonsense", two stars mean "The storyline has some connections with the beginning, but is not understandable", three stars mean "The storyline has some causal connections with the beginning and is understandable", four stars mean "The storyline is causally consistent with the beginning and possibly involves a few grammar mistakes", and five stars mean "Perfect storyline with causal connections and perfect grammar".
We generate the quality ratings from ChatGPT with and without the automatically extracted event causal relations, and compare how they correlate with human ratings.
